subject: Reviewing GNSS Cold Start Regressions after Assistance Cache Rotation
title_ko: Assistance Cache 회전 이후 GNSS Cold Start 회귀 현황 검토
summary_ko: 가상의 Android 유지보수 릴리스 현황 회의에서 주간 privacy-scoped assistance cache 회전과 불확실한 platform time이 겹칠 때 GNSS first fix가 늦어지는 문제를 분석합니다. 팀들은 즉시 cold acquisition, 제한된 shadow promotion, reason-coded outcome, generation·lease 계약과 정량 latency·accuracy·privacy gate를 결정합니다. 모든 인물·조직·단말·도시·receiver·firmware·bundle·빌드·로그·결함·수치·일정은 Business English 교육을 위한 가상 설정이며 실제 기업이나 제품의 실제 결함을 주장하지 않습니다.

turns.speaker: Ethan Brooks
turns.en: Good morning. Jiyun represents Location Framework, Marco represents GNSS HAL and BSP, Leila owns field validation, and I own the R84 maintenance release. Everyone needed for today's decisions is present. We are reviewing a regression in time to first location after the weekly assistance-cache rotation. The symptom appears when a device stays in airplane mode overnight, reconnects in the morning, and launches navigation before network time has fully settled. We need to separate an expired assistance payload, uncertain system time, and receiver behavior. This is a status meeting, so each open item must end with an owner, evidence requirement, due date, and effect on the release gate.
turns.ko: 좋은 아침입니다. Jiyun은 Location Framework, Marco는 GNSS HAL and BSP를 대표하고 Leila는 field validation을 담당하며 저는 R84 maintenance release를 맡았습니다. 오늘 결정에 필요한 담당자가 모두 참석했습니다. 주간 assistance-cache rotation 뒤 첫 위치 결정 시간이 느려지는 회귀를 검토합니다. 단말이 밤새 airplane mode에 있다가 아침에 다시 연결하고 network time이 완전히 안정되기 전에 navigation을 실행할 때 증상이 나타납니다. 만료된 assistance payload, 불확실한 system time, receiver 동작을 분리해야 합니다. 현황 회의이므로 각 open item은 담당자, 필요한 증거, 기한, release gate 영향을 명확히 남겨야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Leila Haddad
turns.en: Field Validation is present. In the R84 candidate, 46 of 1,500 morning-start trials exceeded 45 seconds, compared with 3 of 1,500 on R83. The median remains eight seconds, so the problem hides behind a healthy average. All slow trials followed at least six hours offline and occurred within ninety seconds of connectivity return. They span two device revisions and three cities. Signal conditions were adequate: each trace saw at least twenty-four satellites above our acquisition threshold. The receiver eventually produced a valid fix without reboot. That pattern points away from antenna loss and toward a state-dependent admission problem in the assistance path.
turns.ko: Field Validation이 참석했습니다. R84 candidate에서 아침 시작 시험 1,500회 중 46회가 45초를 넘었고 R83에서는 1,500회 중 3회였습니다. median은 8초로 유지되어 건강해 보이는 평균 뒤에 문제가 숨습니다. 느린 시험은 모두 최소 6시간 offline 뒤에 발생했고 connectivity 복귀 후 90초 이내였습니다. 두 device revision과 세 도시에서 나타났습니다. 신호 조건은 충분했습니다. 각 trace에서 acquisition threshold를 넘는 satellite가 최소 24개였습니다. receiver는 reboot 없이 결국 valid fix를 냈습니다. 이 pattern은 antenna loss보다 assistance path의 state-dependent admission 문제를 가리킵니다.

turns.speaker: Jiyun Choi
turns.en: Location Framework is here. R84 introduced privacy-scoped rotation for the assistance cache. Every Sunday at 03:00 local time, framework invalidates the old download token, requests a fresh coarse-region bundle, and writes a new cache generation. We expected the HAL either to accept the new bundle or to reject it explicitly and start unassisted acquisition. In the failing traces, framework records delivery success at 07:12:04, yet the first HAL status remains assistance-pending until 07:12:41. There is no rejection callback. My team initially classified that as a HAL stall, but the trace lacks the clock-confidence field Marco requested during design review. That omission weakens our attribution.
turns.ko: Location Framework 팀이 참석했습니다. R84는 assistance cache에 privacy-scoped rotation을 도입했습니다. 매주 일요일 현지 시각 03:00에 framework가 이전 download token을 무효화하고 새 coarse-region bundle을 요청하며 새 cache generation을 기록합니다. HAL이 새 bundle을 수락하거나 명시적으로 거부하고 unassisted acquisition을 시작할 것으로 예상했습니다. 실패 trace에서 framework는 07:12:04에 delivery success를 기록하지만 첫 HAL status는 07:12:41까지 assistance-pending입니다. rejection callback은 없습니다. 처음에는 HAL stall로 분류했지만 trace에 Marco가 설계 review에서 요청한 clock-confidence field가 없습니다. 그 누락이 원인 귀속을 약화합니다.

turns.speaker: Marco Silva
turns.en: GNSS HAL and BSP is present. I disagree with the stall label. The receiver accepts orbit data only when its reference time uncertainty is below twelve minutes. After overnight airplane mode, the platform clock can report uncertainty of twenty to thirty-eight minutes until secure network time converges. The HAL currently retains the bundle and retries validation every five seconds because the framework contract says delivery may precede time readiness. That is why no rejection appears. The behavior is deliberate, but the contract never defined a maximum pending interval or a signal for cold-start fallback. We have a policy gap, not proof of a blocked receiver thread. I will show the receiver command timeline before we assign a component defect.
turns.ko: GNSS HAL and BSP 팀이 참석했습니다. stall이라는 표현에는 반대합니다. receiver는 reference time uncertainty가 12분 미만일 때만 orbit data를 수락합니다. 밤새 airplane mode 뒤에는 secure network time이 수렴할 때까지 platform clock uncertainty가 20~38분일 수 있습니다. 현재 HAL은 framework contract가 time readiness 전에 delivery될 수 있다고 하므로 bundle을 보관하고 5초마다 validation을 재시도합니다. 그래서 rejection이 없습니다. 의도된 동작이지만 contract는 최대 pending interval이나 cold-start fallback 신호를 정의하지 않았습니다. blocked receiver thread의 증거가 아니라 policy gap입니다. component defect를 배정하기 전에 receiver command timeline을 보여드리겠습니다.

turns.speaker: Ethan Brooks
turns.en: Let us establish the exact timeline for one representative failure. Airplane mode ends at 07:11:58. Network connectivity is declared at 07:12:01. Framework downloads generation 184 with server expiry at 13:00 and delivers it at 07:12:04. The platform clock reports uncertainty of twenty-six minutes. HAL places the bundle in pending state and begins receiver acquisition at 07:12:06, but it does not mark the session unassisted. Secure time reaches nine-minute uncertainty at 07:12:34. HAL injects the bundle at 07:12:36, and the first fix arrives at 07:12:49. Which delay belongs to useful protection, and which delay is avoidable waiting?
turns.ko: 대표 실패 하나의 정확한 timeline을 세웁시다. airplane mode는 07:11:58에 끝납니다. network connectivity는 07:12:01에 선언됩니다. framework는 server expiry가 13:00인 generation 184를 download하고 07:12:04에 전달합니다. platform clock uncertainty는 26분입니다. HAL은 bundle을 pending state에 두고 07:12:06에 receiver acquisition을 시작하지만 session을 unassisted로 표시하지 않습니다. secure time은 07:12:34에 uncertainty 9분에 도달합니다. HAL은 07:12:36에 bundle을 inject하고 first fix는 07:12:49에 도착합니다. 어느 지연이 유용한 보호이고 어느 지연이 피할 수 있는 대기입니까?

turns.speaker: Marco Silva
turns.en: Rejecting the bundle while time uncertainty is high is useful protection. Injecting orbit data against a poorly bounded clock can place the search window far from the real satellite state and cost more time than a clean cold start. The avoidable part is that our receiver profile remains in assisted-search mode while the bundle is pending. It allocates channels using the untrusted reference window, then resets those channels when injection finally succeeds. My patch starts a true cold search immediately, keeps the bundle outside the receiver, and upgrades the ongoing session only if time becomes qualified within eighteen seconds. After that boundary, the bundle is declined for that session rather than causing a second search reset.
turns.ko: time uncertainty가 높을 때 bundle을 거부하는 것은 유용한 보호입니다. 제대로 제한되지 않은 clock에 orbit data를 inject하면 search window가 실제 satellite state에서 멀어져 깨끗한 cold start보다 더 오래 걸릴 수 있습니다. 피할 수 있는 부분은 bundle이 pending인 동안 receiver profile이 assisted-search mode에 남는 것입니다. 신뢰할 수 없는 reference window로 channel을 할당한 뒤 injection이 성공하면 channel을 reset합니다. 제 patch는 즉시 true cold search를 시작하고 bundle을 receiver 밖에 두며 time이 18초 안에 qualified될 때만 진행 중 session을 upgrade합니다. 그 경계 뒤에는 두 번째 search reset을 일으키지 않고 해당 session에서 bundle을 decline합니다.

turns.speaker: Jiyun Choi
turns.en: I support bounded pending, but I challenge session-only decline. If framework cannot distinguish clock uncertainty from stale payload or unsupported generation, it may download the same bundle again for the next application and repeat the cycle. We need reason-coded outcomes: accepted, pending-clock, expired-server, region-mismatch, generation-rollback, receiver-busy, and malformed. Framework should retain a bundle after pending-clock, discard it after integrity or region failures, and quarantine a generation rollback. The outcome must include bundle generation and session identity. Otherwise our cache metrics will call a successful file transfer a successful assistance use, which is exactly how the tail escaped the R84 dashboard.
turns.ko: bounded pending은 지지하지만 session-only decline에는 이의를 제기합니다. framework가 clock uncertainty와 stale payload 또는 지원되지 않는 generation을 구분하지 못하면 다음 application에서 같은 bundle을 다시 download하고 cycle을 반복할 수 있습니다. accepted, pending-clock, expired-server, region-mismatch, generation-rollback, receiver-busy, malformed의 reason-coded outcome이 필요합니다. framework는 pending-clock 뒤에는 bundle을 유지하고 integrity 또는 region failure 뒤에는 폐기하며 generation rollback은 quarantine해야 합니다. outcome에는 bundle generation과 session identity가 있어야 합니다. 그렇지 않으면 cache metric이 성공한 file transfer를 성공한 assistance 사용으로 부르며 바로 그 때문에 tail이 R84 dashboard에서 빠졌습니다.

turns.speaker: Leila Haddad
turns.en: The field matrix supports both concerns. When I forced qualified time before connectivity, all 600 trials accepted assistance and p99 time to fix was fourteen seconds. When I held uncertainty above twenty minutes, the current build produced 31 slow trials out of 600, while Marco's cold-search prototype produced none above 39 seconds. However, five prototype sessions accepted the bundle at seconds sixteen or seventeen and showed a small accuracy wobble after the upgrade. Horizontal error rose from nine meters to twenty-one meters for two samples before recovering. We cannot define success only by first-fix latency. The gate must cover continuity, accuracy, and whether an upgrade resets measurement state.
turns.ko: field matrix는 두 우려를 모두 뒷받침합니다. connectivity 전에 qualified time을 강제하면 600회 모두 assistance를 수락했고 time-to-fix p99는 14초였습니다. uncertainty를 20분 위로 유지하면 current build는 600회 중 31회가 느렸고 Marco의 cold-search prototype은 39초 초과가 없었습니다. 다만 prototype session 5개는 16~17초에 bundle을 수락한 뒤 upgrade 후 작은 accuracy wobble을 보였습니다. horizontal error가 두 sample 동안 9m에서 21m로 올랐다가 회복했습니다. first-fix latency만으로 성공을 정의할 수 없습니다. gate는 continuity, accuracy, upgrade가 measurement state를 reset하는지도 다뤄야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Ethan Brooks
turns.en: I see three options. Option one reverts cache rotation and ships the old long-lived token, which restores known behavior but abandons the privacy objective. Option two keeps rotation and adds only the eighteen-second cold-search boundary, which improves latency but leaves observability ambiguous. Option three separates the bundle lifecycle from the navigation session: framework owns identity, expiry, and disposition; HAL owns clock qualification and receiver admission; both publish a reason-coded terminal outcome. A pending bundle may upgrade a session once, without resetting solved measurements. My preference is option three, provided we can deliver it without moving the maintenance window. I need each team to identify a disqualifying result.
turns.ko: 세 가지 option이 보입니다. 1안은 cache rotation을 되돌리고 이전 long-lived token을 ship해 알려진 동작을 복구하지만 privacy 목표를 포기합니다. 2안은 rotation을 유지하고 18초 cold-search boundary만 추가해 latency는 개선하지만 observability가 모호하게 남습니다. 3안은 bundle lifecycle과 navigation session을 분리합니다. framework가 identity, expiry, disposition을 소유하고 HAL이 clock qualification과 receiver admission을 소유하며 양쪽이 reason-coded terminal outcome을 게시합니다. pending bundle은 solved measurement를 reset하지 않고 session을 한 번만 upgrade할 수 있습니다. maintenance window를 옮기지 않고 전달할 수 있다면 3안을 선호합니다. 각 팀은 이를 탈락시킬 결과를 밝혀 주십시오.

turns.speaker: Marco Silva
turns.en: HAL rejects option three if an upgrade clears a solved satellite, restarts the navigation epoch, moves horizontal error beyond thirty meters for more than one sample, or injects a bundle after the eighteen-second boundary. We will maintain two receiver lanes: cold acquisition continues independently, and assistance is staged in a shadow context. An atomic promote command applies only unsolved orbit entries and preserves clock and measurement filters. If the receiver firmware lacks shadow promotion, that model remains cold-only for the session; it does not use the old reset path. The status outcome reports promoted-entry count, preserved-satellite count, and exact decline reason without exposing raw location.
turns.ko: HAL은 upgrade가 solved satellite를 지우거나 navigation epoch를 restart하거나 horizontal error를 한 sample 넘게 30m 밖으로 옮기거나 18초 boundary 뒤 bundle을 inject하면 3안을 거부합니다. 두 receiver lane을 유지합니다. cold acquisition은 독립적으로 계속되고 assistance는 shadow context에 staging됩니다. atomic promote command는 unsolved orbit entry에만 적용하고 clock과 measurement filter를 보존합니다. receiver firmware가 shadow promotion을 지원하지 않으면 해당 model은 session 동안 cold-only로 남고 이전 reset path를 사용하지 않습니다. status outcome은 raw location을 노출하지 않고 promoted-entry count, preserved-satellite count, 정확한 decline reason을 보고합니다.

turns.speaker: Jiyun Choi
turns.en: Framework rejects the option if a bundle can be reused across rotation identity, if server expiry is interpreted with unqualified local time, or if unknown outcomes are counted as accepted. The bundle will carry a server-signed expiry interval relative to download receipt, coarse region class, cache generation, and one-time session lease. Framework compares expiry using elapsed realtime, not wall clock. A bundle can survive pending-clock across applications, but each application receives a new lease and HAL may promote it only once. Unknown or duplicate terminal outcomes fail closed to cold-only behavior and raise a bounded diagnostic. There will be no property or application flag that restores the legacy reset path.
turns.ko: framework는 bundle이 rotation identity를 넘어 재사용되거나 server expiry가 qualified되지 않은 local time으로 해석되거나 unknown outcome이 accepted로 count되면 option을 거부합니다. bundle은 download receipt 기준 server-signed expiry interval, coarse region class, cache generation, one-time session lease를 담습니다. framework는 wall clock이 아니라 elapsed realtime으로 expiry를 비교합니다. bundle은 application 간 pending-clock 상태로 살아남을 수 있지만 각 application은 새 lease를 받고 HAL은 한 번만 promote할 수 있습니다. unknown 또는 duplicate terminal outcome은 cold-only behavior로 fail closed하고 제한된 diagnostic을 냅니다. legacy reset path를 복원하는 property나 application flag는 없습니다.

turns.speaker: Leila Haddad
turns.en: Validation will run 4,200 sessions across two receiver firmware versions, two device revisions, three clock-confidence bands, airplane mode durations of two, six, and twelve hours, and warm versus cold ambient conditions. Acceptance requires p99 first fix below thirty-five seconds, zero fixes above fifty seconds, no navigation epoch restart, no solved-satellite loss, horizontal error below thirty meters after promotion, and exactly one terminal outcome per lease. Privacy logging must contain generation, confidence band, outcome, timing band, and model class only. We will add 240 fault sequences for expired bundles, duplicated outcomes, generation rollback, malformed signatures, connectivity loss, and process death during promotion.
turns.ko: Validation은 receiver firmware version 두 개, device revision 두 개, clock-confidence band 세 개, airplane mode duration 2·6·12시간, warm·cold ambient 조건에 걸쳐 session 4,200회를 실행합니다. 승인은 first-fix p99 35초 미만, 50초 초과 fix 0건, navigation epoch restart 0건, solved-satellite loss 0건, promotion 후 horizontal error 30m 미만, lease당 terminal outcome 정확히 1개를 요구합니다. privacy logging은 generation, confidence band, outcome, timing band, model class만 포함해야 합니다. expired bundle, duplicate outcome, generation rollback, malformed signature, connectivity loss, promotion 중 process death에 대한 fault sequence 240개도 추가합니다.

turns.speaker: Ethan Brooks
turns.en: The decision is option three. R84 keeps privacy-scoped weekly cache rotation. Framework owns signed bundle identity, elapsed-time expiry, generation, session lease, and disposition. HAL starts cold acquisition immediately when time is unqualified, stages assistance outside the active receiver state, and may atomically promote unsolved entries once within eighteen seconds. Every lease ends in one reason-coded outcome. Unsupported firmware stays cold-only rather than using a reset-based upgrade. The release gate covers latency, continuity, accuracy, outcome accounting, and privacy on one immutable framework-HAL-firmware set. I own the risk register, scope control, and final go or defer recommendation.
turns.ko: 결정은 3안입니다. R84는 privacy-scoped weekly cache rotation을 유지합니다. framework가 signed bundle identity, elapsed-time expiry, generation, session lease, disposition을 소유합니다. HAL은 time이 unqualified이면 cold acquisition을 즉시 시작하고 active receiver state 밖에 assistance를 staging하며 18초 안에 unsolved entry를 한 번 atomic promote할 수 있습니다. 모든 lease는 하나의 reason-coded outcome으로 끝납니다. 지원되지 않는 firmware는 reset 기반 upgrade를 쓰지 않고 cold-only로 남습니다. release gate는 하나의 immutable framework-HAL-firmware set에서 latency, continuity, accuracy, outcome accounting, privacy를 다룹니다. 저는 risk register, scope control, 최종 go 또는 defer 권고를 담당합니다.

turns.speaker: Jiyun Choi
turns.en: Location Framework accepts. I own the bundle schema, elapsed-time expiry, lease table, outcome reconciliation, and dashboard changes. The schema and state machine are due Wednesday, November 25 at 16:00 KST. A reviewable framework build is due Thursday, November 26 at 19:00 KST. By Friday at 13:00 KST, I will provide negative tests for duplicate lease, rotation overlap, rollback generation, unknown outcome, process restart, and wall-clock jump. The dashboard will separate downloaded, offered, pending-clock, promoted, declined, and quarantined. It will display tail latency by confidence band, so a stable median can no longer hide a degraded cohort.
turns.ko: Location Framework은 수락합니다. bundle schema, elapsed-time expiry, lease table, outcome reconciliation, dashboard 변경을 담당합니다. schema와 state machine은 11월 25일 수요일 KST 16:00까지입니다. review 가능한 framework build는 11월 26일 목요일 KST 19:00까지입니다. 금요일 KST 13:00까지 duplicate lease, rotation overlap, rollback generation, unknown outcome, process restart, wall-clock jump의 negative test를 제공합니다. dashboard는 downloaded, offered, pending-clock, promoted, declined, quarantined를 분리합니다. confidence band별 tail latency를 보여 안정적인 median이 degraded cohort를 더는 숨기지 못하게 합니다.

turns.speaker: Marco Silva
turns.en: GNSS HAL and BSP accepts. I own the shadow context, eighteen-second boundary, atomic promotion, outcome reasons, and firmware capability query. The HAL interface draft is due November 25 at 18:00 KST. The prototype for both supported firmware branches is due November 27 at 12:00 KST. If the older branch cannot preserve solved measurements, I will mark it cold-only and document the expected latency rather than emulate promotion in framework. Receiver traces will expose command order, entry counts, epoch continuity, and clock-confidence transitions in engineering builds. Production events will never contain coordinates, satellite identifiers, raw timestamps, or assistance payload content.
turns.ko: GNSS HAL and BSP는 수락합니다. shadow context, 18초 boundary, atomic promotion, outcome reason, firmware capability query를 담당합니다. HAL interface draft는 11월 25일 KST 18:00까지입니다. 지원 firmware branch 두 개의 prototype은 11월 27일 KST 12:00까지입니다. 이전 branch가 solved measurement를 보존하지 못하면 framework에서 promotion을 흉내 내지 않고 cold-only로 표시하며 예상 latency를 문서화합니다. engineering build의 receiver trace는 command order, entry count, epoch continuity, clock-confidence transition을 노출합니다. production event에는 coordinate, satellite identifier, raw timestamp, assistance payload content가 절대 들어가지 않습니다.

turns.speaker: Leila Haddad
turns.en: Field Validation accepts. Static artifact checks begin November 27 at 17:00 KST. Hardware execution starts Saturday, November 28 at 08:00 KST. I will publish a 1,050-session interim ledger by November 29 at 17:00 KST and the complete 4,200-session report by December 2 at 15:00 KST. The 240 fault sequences remain in a separate ledger and do not improve the normal-session denominator. Any changed framework, HAL, or firmware digest starts a new ledger. Missing cells remain missing; we will not substitute a different city, receiver branch, or clock band. The report will list every distinct failure signature and retain failed runs in the denominator.
turns.ko: Field Validation은 수락합니다. static artifact check는 11월 27일 KST 17:00에 시작합니다. hardware 실행은 11월 28일 토요일 KST 08:00에 시작합니다. 1,050-session interim ledger는 11월 29일 KST 17:00까지, 전체 4,200-session report는 12월 2일 KST 15:00까지 게시합니다. fault sequence 240개는 별도 ledger에 남고 normal-session 분모를 개선하지 않습니다. framework, HAL, firmware digest 중 하나라도 바뀌면 새 ledger를 시작합니다. missing cell은 missing으로 남기고 다른 도시, receiver branch, clock band로 대체하지 않습니다. report는 서로 다른 모든 failure signature를 나열하고 실패 run을 분모에 유지합니다.

turns.speaker: Ethan Brooks
turns.en: The scope is frozen. We are not changing the assistance server, navigation application, antenna configuration, or general time-synchronization service in this maintenance item. If evidence points to one of those components, we record a separate issue rather than quietly expanding this patch. Owners must acknowledge dates in the tracker by 11:00 KST today. We will hold our initial evidence checkpoint on Sunday, November 29, 2026, between 18:00 and 18:45 Korea Standard Time. Bring both interface reviews, the immutable artifact digests, static checks, the first 1,050-session ledger, and the open-risk list. A missing artifact is not a provisional pass.
turns.ko: 범위를 고정합니다. 이번 maintenance item에서 assistance server, navigation application, antenna configuration, 일반 time-synchronization service는 변경하지 않습니다. 증거가 그 component 중 하나를 가리키면 patch 범위를 조용히 넓히지 않고 별도 issue를 기록합니다. 담당자는 오늘 KST 11:00까지 tracker에서 일정을 확인해야 합니다. 첫 evidence checkpoint는 2026년 11월 29일 일요일 한국 표준시 18:00~18:45에 엽니다. 두 interface review, immutable artifact digest, static check, 첫 1,050-session ledger, open-risk list를 가져오십시오. 누락된 artifact는 provisional pass가 아닙니다.

turns.speaker: Jiyun Choi
turns.en: At the review, I will demonstrate reconciliation with one happy path and every terminal reason. The lease table must reach zero open entries after application death, connectivity loss, cache rotation, and device reboot. A diagnostic upload failure cannot keep a lease alive or change its disposition. I will also show that coarse region class is computed before storage and that the raw download request is not retained. If privacy review rejects an event field, local validation may use an engineering-only trace, but production schema will omit the field. Observability must remain proportional to the release decision rather than become a second location history.
turns.ko: review에서 happy path 하나와 모든 terminal reason의 reconciliation을 시연하겠습니다. application death, connectivity loss, cache rotation, device reboot 뒤 lease table은 open entry 0개에 도달해야 합니다. diagnostic upload failure가 lease를 살려 두거나 disposition을 바꿔서는 안 됩니다. coarse region class가 storage 전에 계산되고 raw download request가 보존되지 않는지도 보여드리겠습니다. privacy review가 event field를 거부하면 local validation은 engineering-only trace를 쓸 수 있지만 production schema는 그 field를 생략합니다. observability는 두 번째 location history가 되지 않고 release decision에 비례해야 합니다.

turns.speaker: Marco Silva
turns.en: I will bring side-by-side receiver traces for current behavior, qualified-time acceptance, bounded pending with promotion, and cold-only fallback. Reviewers should see that cold acquisition never pauses while a bundle waits. Promotion must add unsolved entries without clearing the navigation epoch or measurement filter. If a firmware capability query times out, HAL chooses cold-only and emits receiver-busy; it does not guess support. The capability result is cached only for the running HAL process and is rechecked after firmware restart. This prevents a stale capability bit from authorizing promotion after a receiver recovery or component rollback.
turns.ko: current behavior, qualified-time acceptance, bounded pending with promotion, cold-only fallback의 receiver trace를 나란히 가져오겠습니다. reviewer는 bundle이 기다리는 동안 cold acquisition이 절대 멈추지 않는 것을 볼 수 있어야 합니다. promotion은 navigation epoch나 measurement filter를 지우지 않고 unsolved entry를 추가해야 합니다. firmware capability query가 timeout되면 HAL은 support를 추측하지 않고 cold-only를 선택하며 receiver-busy를 냅니다. capability result는 실행 중 HAL process에만 cache되고 firmware restart 뒤 다시 확인됩니다. 이는 receiver recovery나 component rollback 뒤 stale capability bit가 promotion을 허가하는 것을 막습니다.

turns.speaker: Leila Haddad
turns.en: My interim report will not declare success after 1,050 sessions. It will show coverage completed, missing cells, failure signatures, and whether the evidence still supports full execution. We will use a predeclared stop rule: any navigation epoch restart, wrong-generation promotion, duplicate terminal outcome, raw-location production log, or fix beyond fifty seconds pauses the matrix immediately. The failed run stays in the denominator, and a corrected artifact starts again under a new digest. Ordinary accuracy excursions below the hard stop continue to the planned sample size so we can estimate their rate instead of optimizing around the first observation.
turns.ko: interim report는 1,050 session 뒤 성공을 선언하지 않습니다. 완료 coverage, missing cell, failure signature, 증거가 full execution을 계속 지지하는지를 보여줍니다. 사전 선언 stop rule을 사용합니다. navigation epoch restart, wrong-generation promotion, duplicate terminal outcome, raw-location production log, 50초 초과 fix가 하나라도 나오면 matrix를 즉시 중단합니다. 실패 run은 분모에 남고 수정 artifact는 새 digest 아래 다시 시작합니다. hard stop보다 낮은 일반 accuracy excursion은 첫 관측에 맞춰 최적화하지 않고 발생률을 추정하도록 계획된 sample size까지 계속합니다.

turns.speaker: Ethan Brooks
turns.en: That completes the record. The final go or defer review is Thursday, December 3, 2026, at 10:00 Korea Standard Time, after Leila's complete report and the privacy sign-off. We will decide whether the new contract enters R84, whether older firmware remains cold-only, and whether any model needs a separate maintenance train. Requests to restore the legacy token, extend promotion beyond eighteen seconds, treat unknown outcomes as accepted, or merge ledgers across digests require a new decision meeting. Until the gate passes, the rollout remains at the internal cohort. Thank you; please publish your acknowledged dates and first risk updates before today's cutoff.
turns.ko: 기록을 마칩니다. 최종 go 또는 defer review는 Leila의 전체 report와 privacy sign-off 뒤인 2026년 12월 3일 목요일 한국 표준시 10:00입니다. 새 contract를 R84에 넣을지, 이전 firmware를 cold-only로 유지할지, 어떤 model에 별도 maintenance train이 필요한지 결정합니다. legacy token 복원, promotion을 18초 너머로 연장, unknown outcome을 accepted로 처리, digest 간 ledger 병합 요청에는 새 decision meeting이 필요합니다. gate 통과 전까지 rollout은 internal cohort에 남습니다. 감사합니다. 오늘 cutoff 전에 확인한 일정과 첫 risk update를 게시하십시오.

expressions.example: Field Validation is present. In the R84 candidate, 46 of 1,500 morning-start trials exceeded 45 seconds, compared with 3 of 1,500 on R83. The median remains eight seconds, so the problem hides behind a healthy average. All slow trials followed at least six hours offline and occurred within ninety seconds of connectivity return. They span two device revisions and three cities. Signal conditions were adequate: each trace saw at least twenty-four satellites above our acquisition threshold. The receiver eventually produced a valid fix without reboot. That pattern points away from antenna loss and toward a state-dependent admission problem in the assistance path.
expressions.practice: A healthy average can still conceal a severe regional tail.

expressions.example: GNSS HAL and BSP is present. I disagree with the stall label. The receiver accepts orbit data only when its reference time uncertainty is below twelve minutes. After overnight airplane mode, the platform clock can report uncertainty of twenty to thirty-eight minutes until secure network time converges. The HAL currently retains the bundle and retries validation every five seconds because the framework contract says delivery may precede time readiness. That is why no rejection appears. The behavior is deliberate, but the contract never defined a maximum pending interval or a signal for cold-start fallback. We have a policy gap, not proof of a blocked receiver thread. I will show the receiver command timeline before we assign a component defect.
expressions.practice: The missing retry limit is a policy gap between two services.

expressions.example: Let us establish the exact timeline for one representative failure. Airplane mode ends at 07:11:58. Network connectivity is declared at 07:12:01. Framework downloads generation 184 with server expiry at 13:00 and delivers it at 07:12:04. The platform clock reports uncertainty of twenty-six minutes. HAL places the bundle in pending state and begins receiver acquisition at 07:12:06, but it does not mark the session unassisted. Secure time reaches nine-minute uncertainty at 07:12:34. HAL injects the bundle at 07:12:36, and the first fix arrives at 07:12:49. Which delay belongs to useful protection, and which delay is avoidable waiting?
expressions.practice: Build the exact timeline before assigning the regression.

expressions.usage_ko: assistance 없는 초기 탐색을 말할 때
expressions.example: Rejecting the bundle while time uncertainty is high is useful protection. Injecting orbit data against a poorly bounded clock can place the search window far from the real satellite state and cost more time than a clean cold start. The avoidable part is that our receiver profile remains in assisted-search mode while the bundle is pending. It allocates channels using the untrusted reference window, then resets those channels when injection finally succeeds. My patch starts a true cold search immediately, keeps the bundle outside the receiver, and upgrades the ongoing session only if time becomes qualified within eighteen seconds. After that boundary, the bundle is declined for that session rather than causing a second search reset.
expressions.practice: Compare assisted recovery with a clean cold start.

expressions.example: I support bounded pending, but I challenge session-only decline. If framework cannot distinguish clock uncertainty from stale payload or unsupported generation, it may download the same bundle again for the next application and repeat the cycle. We need reason-coded outcomes: accepted, pending-clock, expired-server, region-mismatch, generation-rollback, receiver-busy, and malformed. Framework should retain a bundle after pending-clock, discard it after integrity or region failures, and quarantine a generation rollback. The outcome must include bundle generation and session identity. Otherwise our cache metrics will call a successful file transfer a successful assistance use, which is exactly how the tail escaped the R84 dashboard.
expressions.practice: The API should return reason-coded outcomes for every rejection.

expressions.usage_ko: 특정 상태에서만 입력이 수락되지 않을 때
expressions.example: Field Validation is present. In the R84 candidate, 46 of 1,500 morning-start trials exceeded 45 seconds, compared with 3 of 1,500 on R83. The median remains eight seconds, so the problem hides behind a healthy average. All slow trials followed at least six hours offline and occurred within ninety seconds of connectivity return. They span two device revisions and three cities. Signal conditions were adequate: each trace saw at least twenty-four satellites above our acquisition threshold. The receiver eventually produced a valid fix without reboot. That pattern points away from antenna loss and toward a state-dependent admission problem in the assistance path.
expressions.practice: The traces suggest a state-dependent admission problem.

expressions.example: I see three options. Option one reverts cache rotation and ships the old long-lived token, which restores known behavior but abandons the privacy objective. Option two keeps rotation and adds only the eighteen-second cold-search boundary, which improves latency but leaves observability ambiguous. Option three separates the bundle lifecycle from the navigation session: framework owns identity, expiry, and disposition; HAL owns clock qualification and receiver admission; both publish a reason-coded terminal outcome. A pending bundle may upgrade a session once, without resetting solved measurements. My preference is option three, provided we can deliver it without moving the maintenance window. I need each team to identify a disqualifying result.
expressions.practice: Name one disqualifying result for the preferred option.

expressions.usage_ko: active state 밖에서 데이터를 준비할 때
expressions.example: HAL rejects option three if an upgrade clears a solved satellite, restarts the navigation epoch, moves horizontal error beyond thirty meters for more than one sample, or injects a bundle after the eighteen-second boundary. We will maintain two receiver lanes: cold acquisition continues independently, and assistance is staged in a shadow context. An atomic promote command applies only unsolved orbit entries and preserves clock and measurement filters. If the receiver firmware lacks shadow promotion, that model remains cold-only for the session; it does not use the old reset path. The status outcome reports promoted-entry count, preserved-satellite count, and exact decline reason without exposing raw location.
expressions.practice: Stage the new table in a shadow context before activation.

expressions.example: Framework rejects the option if a bundle can be reused across rotation identity, if server expiry is interpreted with unqualified local time, or if unknown outcomes are counted as accepted. The bundle will carry a server-signed expiry interval relative to download receipt, coarse region class, cache generation, and one-time session lease. Framework compares expiry using elapsed realtime, not wall clock. A bundle can survive pending-clock across applications, but each application receives a new lease and HAL may promote it only once. Unknown or duplicate terminal outcomes fail closed to cold-only behavior and raise a bounded diagnostic. There will be no property or application flag that restores the legacy reset path.
expressions.practice: Unknown capability values must fail closed.

expressions.usage_ko: 동일 artifact 조합 검증을 강조할 때
expressions.example: The decision is option three. R84 keeps privacy-scoped weekly cache rotation. Framework owns signed bundle identity, elapsed-time expiry, generation, session lease, and disposition. HAL starts cold acquisition immediately when time is unqualified, stages assistance outside the active receiver state, and may atomically promote unsolved entries once within eighteen seconds. Every lease ends in one reason-coded outcome. Unsupported firmware stays cold-only rather than using a reset-based upgrade. The release gate covers latency, continuity, accuracy, outcome accounting, and privacy on one immutable framework-HAL-firmware set. I own the risk register, scope control, and final go or defer recommendation.
expressions.practice: Run the matrix on one immutable framework-HAL-firmware set.

expressions.example: Location Framework accepts. I own the bundle schema, elapsed-time expiry, lease table, outcome reconciliation, and dashboard changes. The schema and state machine are due Wednesday, November 25 at 16:00 KST. A reviewable framework build is due Thursday, November 26 at 19:00 KST. By Friday at 13:00 KST, I will provide negative tests for duplicate lease, rotation overlap, rollback generation, unknown outcome, process restart, and wall-clock jump. The dashboard will separate downloaded, offered, pending-clock, promoted, declined, and quarantined. It will display tail latency by confidence band, so a stable median can no longer hide a degraded cohort.
expressions.practice: A stable median does not prove every cohort is healthy.

expressions.example: Field Validation accepts. Static artifact checks begin November 27 at 17:00 KST. Hardware execution starts Saturday, November 28 at 08:00 KST. I will publish a 1,050-session interim ledger by November 29 at 17:00 KST and the complete 4,200-session report by December 2 at 15:00 KST. The 240 fault sequences remain in a separate ledger and do not improve the normal-session denominator. Any changed framework, HAL, or firmware digest starts a new ledger. Missing cells remain missing; we will not substitute a different city, receiver branch, or clock band. The report will list every distinct failure signature and retain failed runs in the denominator.
expressions.practice: Fault-injection results should remain in a separate ledger.

expressions.example: The scope is frozen. We are not changing the assistance server, navigation application, antenna configuration, or general time-synchronization service in this maintenance item. If evidence points to one of those components, we record a separate issue rather than quietly expanding this patch. Owners must acknowledge dates in the tracker by 11:00 KST today. We will hold our initial evidence checkpoint on Sunday, November 29, 2026, between 18:00 and 18:45 Korea Standard Time. Bring both interface reviews, the immutable artifact digests, static checks, the first 1,050-session ledger, and the open-risk list. A missing artifact is not a provisional pass.
expressions.practice: The scope is frozen after the interface review.
